text: Count Athena's 'fails without the fix' runs as commands seen running. Since 64cb889 Athena runs each planned revert demonstration and shows it to the verifier under 'Checks Athena ran on this tree', but the run is not written to verification.json checks, so the verdict's seen-running rule (D43, crates/athena-core/src/verify.rs) does not count it. Job 20261104-081830-js1p was rejected only on this: the verifier quoted Athena's revert record fails-without-1 (both new tests failed on the base code, exit 101) and the criterion still came out unmet with commands_verified false. Record each demonstration run in the verification record's checks (name, command, exit code, output tail, marked as a revert run), and let a behavior criterion that cites that record's command, or its record name, count as seen running for the 'fails without the fix' part. Acceptance: a test where a criterion citing a recorded revert run is met with commands_verified true; a test where a criterion citing a command neither run nor recorded stays unseen.
